name: 40502 · Lexington, KY
findings: ZIP 40502 (Lexington) has 182 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40502 (Lexington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
